title: GRTeclyn research fork — Bondi dipole campaign
description:
Code, run matrix and packed campaign data behind The Bondi Dipole in Full Numerical Relativity: a Self-Accelerating Positive-Negative Mass Binary (arXiv:2608.24577).

A GRTeclyn (AMReX/GPU) research fork with a Python orchestration layer: GRTresna constraint-solved initial data for dressed soliton stars of both mass signs, CCZ4 evolution of a bicomplex scalar in which only the phantom sector enters Einstein's equations with a minus sign, and the diagnostics that measure the runaway. Includes the scrubbed per-cell time series, dressed-star tables, solve and evolution parameters, curated frames and movies, and the refit tooling — reproducible without a GPU.
